jobs.name: 古希腊哲学
jobs.cue: This target is a classical fresco of the School of Athens. Preserve ALL of the existing fresco itself, including the recognizable central two philosophers and their opposite hand gestures, every scholarly group, the reclining figure on the stairs, foreground geometrical demonstration at right, seated writers at left, full arch ornament, statues, vaults and checkerboard floor. Preserve its authentic fresco painterly material and pale colors; NEVER reinterpret it as a photograph or oil-rendered imitation. Expand only lateral architectural continuation in matching painted perspective. Do not alter figures or center architecture, do not add people or inscriptions, do not paint over any original content.
jobs.prompt: Use case: outpainting of a museum painting. Produce one horizontal 16:9 academic fresco scene based on the attached classical artwork. Preserve the actual central scholarly gathering, all scholars' clothing, individual faces, intellectual gestures, relative placement, groups drawing geometry and reading books, seated and reclining thinkers on the stone steps, the painted decorative arch and full foreground floor. Maintain the fresco's pale painterly material, its old architectural motifs, exact perspective and colors. Extend only the left/right architecture; do not crop any top or bottom content. Keep all human figures and stone statues in dignified, modest classical robes covering their torsos and hips; if the existing decorative stone statues lack complete drapery, add subtle matching sculptural robes only there. No other human-body changes. The subject is scholarly conversation in a historic academic hall, with no sexual activity, suggestive framing or adult themes. No extra people, modern objects, captions, watermark or comparison panel.
